items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: I said, no, my friend. ... I knew his sisters, his brothers, his father. We went to his father's wake and funeral.

ctx.x: Well, now, Parquet, he was sort of a Mexican type, but not Poikins. Not Poikins. I had one fellow, one of these writers come here one day, and he asked me, he said, Yala Nunes, Yala Nunes was a nigger. I said, oh, no.
